title: App Permissions
about: Choose what each app can use, and change it any time.

cards.prompt: Sam installs a drawing game. **Flip each switch** to see what it can reach.
cards.explanation: Each switch lets the app reach one more part of Sam's phone.

cards.prompt: The game asks for Sam's contacts. Sam taps Don't allow. **What happens?**

image.alt: The drawing game with a half-drawn cat and a row of brush colours. Over it, a pop-up: Allow Drawing game to see your contacts? with Don't allow and Allow. A finger is on Don't allow.
image.revealAlt: The pop-up is gone. The cat is finished in bright colours and the brushes work. A small crossed-out contacts icon says Contacts: off.

cards.explanation: Drawing never needed Sam's contacts, so the game works fine without them.

cards.title: App permissions
cards.body: An **app permission** is your OK for an app to use your camera, microphone, location or contacts. Allow only what it needs, and change it any time in **Settings**.

image.alt: The same pop-up, labelled app permission. Under it, the four things an app can ask for: camera, microphone, location and contacts. A Settings gear has an arrow: change any time.

cards.prompt: Four apps each ask for one thing. **Drag** each into Needs it or Doesn't need it.
cards.explanation: Allow what fits the app's job: a torch needs light, not your contacts.
cards.nudge: For each one, ask: could the app do its main job without it?
cards.showAnswer: Maps and video calls need theirs; a torch and a calculator don't need contacts or location.

cards.prompt: Sam wants directions to the skate park. The map asks for location. **Tap the best button.**

image.alt: A map app with a pin: Skate park. Over it, a pop-up: Allow Maps to use your location? with three buttons: Always (even when closed), Only while using the app, and Don't allow.
image.revealAlt: A route line runs from Sam to the skate park. Beside it, a closed phone with a crossed-out pin: Closed: can't see you.

options.nudge: Does the map need to know where Sam is when it's closed?
Can a map give directions without knowing where Sam is?

cards.explanation: The directions work, and the map can only use Sam's location while Sam's using it.
cards.showAnswer: Only while using the app: the map works, and it can't follow Sam once Sam stops using it.

cards.prompt: This dot means an app is using your mic. You're not on a call. **Tap what you do.**

image.alt: The top of your phone screen, zoomed in: the time 3:45, the battery, and a small glowing orange dot labelled mic in use (on many phones). Below, the home screen, with no call open.
image.revealAlt: Settings open at Microphone: a list of apps with switches. Sticker app is switched off, and the orange dot is gone from the top of the screen.

options.text: Ignore it: dots like this are normal
options.nudge: No call is on: should any app be using your mic right now?

options.text: Restart the phone so the app stops
options.nudge: After a restart, would the app still have its permission?

options.text: Switch that app's mic off in Settings

cards.explanation: Settings takes the permission back, so that app can't use the mic again.
cards.showAnswer: Find the app and switch its mic off in Settings: that takes the permission back.

cards.title: Recap
cards.body:
Only let an app use what it needs for its job, and change your mind any time in **Settings**.

**Try this:** Open Settings and switch one app's location to "Only while using the app".

**Next:** The café Wi-Fi that isn't really the café's.
